resources.string: FieldPass compares your check-in photos with one approved photo of your face. Faculty must approve your photo before attendance checks can work.
Take a clear photo of your face with the front camera. It is sent to the server for faculty to review.
Your photo was sent on %1$s. You can not check in until faculty approves it. Pull down to refresh.
Approved by %1$s on %2$s. You can check in to your activities.
Faculty could not approve this photo. Please take a new one.
Approval does not carry over to a new photo. Until faculty approves the new one, you will not be able to check in.
Your whole face should be clear and well lit, and only you should be in the picture.
